T1059.001.title: sec-4688-encoded-powershell
T1059.001.logic: SecurityEvent | where NewProcessName endswith 'powershell.exe' and CommandLine matches regex '-e[ncodema]* [A-Za-z0-9+/=]{30,}'

T1059.003.title: Suspicious cmd.exe child of Office
T1059.003.logic: index=win EventCode=1 ParentImage=*winword.exe Image=*cmd.exe | stats count by host,User

T1047.title: WmiPrvSE spawning shells
T1047.logic: Sysmon 1 | where ParentImage endswith 'WmiPrvSE.exe' and Image has_any ('cmd.exe','powershell.exe')

T1053.005.title: sec-4698-scheduled-task-created
T1053.005.logic: SecurityEvent EventID==4698 | parse task XML for Command/Arguments; flag scripting hosts & user-writable paths

T1543.003.title: sec-7045-new-service-installed
T1543.003.logic: union SecurityEvent(4697), Event(System 7045) | where ImagePath suspicious or random 8-16 char name

T1098.title: sec-4728-4732-privileged-group-add
T1098.logic: SecurityEvent EventID in (4728,4732,4756) and GroupName in tier0 list

T1070.001.title: Windows Event Log Cleared (1102/104)
T1070.001.logic: index=win (EventCode=1102 OR EventCode=104) | stats count by host,user

T1562.002.title: sec-4719-audit-policy-changed
T1562.002.logic: SecurityEvent EventID==4719 removing success/failure auditing by human account

T1003.001.title: mde-lsass-memory-dump
T1003.001.logic: DeviceProcessEvents | procdump/comsvcs MiniDump/known dumpers targeting lsass

T1003.001.title: LSASS Access by Non-Allowlisted Process
T1003.001.logic: Sysmon 10 TargetImage=lsass.exe AND SourceImage NOT in allowlist AND GrantedAccess in (0x1010,0x1410,0x1fffff)

T1110.003.title: signin-password-spray-by-ip / sec-4776-ntlm-password-spray
T1110.003.logic: group failures by source; DistinctUsers>=10 AND AttemptsPerAccount<=3 within 1h

T1110.003.title: Password Spraying - One Source Many Accounts
T1110.003.logic: EventCode=4625 | stats dc(Account_Name) as users by src | where users>=10

T1558.003.title: Kerberoasting - RC4 Service Ticket Requests
T1558.003.logic: Security 4769 TicketEncryptionType=0x17 AND ServiceName != krbtgt | stats by Account

T1021.001.title: tdl-005 RDP to multiple hosts by one user
T1021.001.logic: Security 4624 LogonType==10 | summarize dc(Computer) by Account within 1h >= N

T1021.002.title: SMB Admin Share Fan-Out
T1021.002.logic: EventCode=5140 ShareName in (ADMIN$,C$) | stats dc(dest) by src_user

T1071.001.title: csl-firewall-beaconing
T1071.001.logic: CommonSecurityLog | inter-arrival via prev(); >=20 conns, jitter<10%, period 30s-1h

T1071.001.title: tdl-011 Beaconing Regular Interval
T1071.001.logic: compute delta between outbound conns per src,dst,port; low stdev/mean

T1071.004.title: tdl-009/010 DNS Tunneling
T1071.004.logic: dns | eval len=len(query) | stats avg(len) dc(subdomain) by domain | where long names / many subdomains

T1105.title: Certutil/BITS/PowerShell Download Cradle
T1105.logic: process in (certutil,bitsadmin,powershell) AND command_line contains url / '-urlcache' / 'DownloadString'

T1486.title: Mass File Modification (Ransomware)
T1486.logic: Sysmon 11 | high rate of writes/renames with uncommon extension by one process

T1490.title: Shadow Copy / Backup Deletion
T1490.logic: EventCode=1 (Image=*vssadmin* delete shadows OR *wbadmin* delete OR *bcdedit* recoveryenabled no)

T1078.title: signin-high-risk-successful / impossible-travel
T1078.logic: SigninLogs RiskLevelDuringSignIn=high ResultType=0; or geo-velocity > threshold
